# runr_cost_limit (Resource)

The monthly cost limit of a pay-as-you-go project ([monthly cost limit](https://runr.sh/docs/billing/#monthly-cost-limit)): one amount in the billing currency, and what happens when the month's cost reaches it — `notify` the owner, or `stop` the project as an administrator would. At 80 % the owner is warned. A limit is checked when it is saved, so a `stop` limit at or below this month so far stops the project at once. A fixed-price project has no limit (the API refuses it with `cost_limit_not_available`); without the Billing module there are no limits.

Destroying the resource removes the limit; a project the limit stopped stays stopped until it is resumed (Resume on the project's Billing tab, `POST /api/projects/{project}/billing/cost-limit/resume`, or `runr projects resume`) — or RunR resumes it when the next month begins. The month's figures are in the `runr_cost_limit` data source. Needs the project's owner, `projects.billing` on the project or `billing.manage`. Import with the project's name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# 150.00 a month in the billing currency; the project is stopped when this month reaches it
# (the owner is warned at 80 %).
resource "runr_cost_limit" "api" {
  project_id = runr_project.api.id
  amount     = 150
  action     = "stop"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `action` (String) At 100 %: `notify` (the project keeps running) or `stop` (the project is stopped).
- `amount` (Number) The limit per calendar month in the billing currency: greater than 0, at most three decimals.
- `project_id` (String) Project id. Changing it moves the limit to another project.

### Optional

- `currency` (String) The billing currency of the installation (computed). Set it to make the apply fail when the installation bills in another currency.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The project id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# <project name or id>
terraform import runr_cost_limit.api orders-api
```
